description: Q9 unlabeled compatibility pair list. This file intentionally contains no expected_compatible labels and must not be used for scorer tuning. Predictions should be locked before labels are revealed from a separate Q9 labels file.
selection_policy: Forty source-backed material/interface pairs selected across battery, polymer, ceramic, metal, semiconductor, glass, and cross-domain compatibility surfaces. Exact Q8 pair identities were avoided. Materials are common engineering or product-relevant systems rather than Q8-specific patches.
holdout_policy: Freeze this pair list before scoring. Run model predictions against this unlabeled file and save locked predictions. Only then merge labels from a separate hidden labels file for metric computation. Q8 remains a spent diagnostic set and must not be reported as a new blind result.

pairs.citation: Composite solid polymer electrolyte literature, ceramic filler-polymer matrix systems
pairs.evidence_basis: PAN composite polymer electrolytes with LLZO filler are standard/workable

pairs.citation: Solid-state battery separator/support polymer compatibility reports
pairs.evidence_basis: PPS is chemically inert, thermally stable -> fine as inert support
